structured.answer: I didn't find what the account costs me, because there isn't a single fee amount on the page. All I understood is that more than about 15,000 ₪ shouldn't sit in the עו"ש, because it loses value (10,000 becomes 8,203 in ten years). I'll ask my son or the bank what to do with the rest.

stuck.why: The chart says the price of leaving the money is 2,576 ₪, but above it says 1,797 ₪ less. I didn't understand which number is right.
I came for the fees. There's only a link 'עמלות ומחירים' and the words 'מסלול בסיסי/מורחב', with no amount.
This scared me about my deposits. I stopped and wasn't sure whether to keep reading.
